title: Polynomial-Time Gate Evaluation
statement: The function that initializes the encoded gate-evaluation state from an input bit string, iterates the gate-state update for the prescribed number of rounds, and returns the second component of the resulting state is polynomial-time computable. Thus a deterministic Turing machine with finitely many states computes it on every input of length $n$ within $C(n+1)^c$ steps for some $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$.
